---
name: New Language Request
about: Propose adding support for a programming language not currently configured.
title: "[LANG] Add support for <Language>"
labels: ["enhancement", "new-language"]
assignees: ""
---

### Language Name
e.g. Haskell, Scala, Zig, Lua, etc.

### Common File Extensions
e.g. `.hs`, `.scala`, `.zig`, `.lua`

### Desired Emoji / Icon
e.g. ⚡, 💎, 🟣, 🌀

### Suggested Priority Order
Where should this language sit relative to existing languages in `LANGUAGE_CONFIG`?

### Template Snippet
If possible, please provide a starter boilerplate comment / class template for this language:
```text
// Paste example starter template here
```

### Willingness to submit a PR
- [ ] Yes, I would like to submit a Pull Request to implement this!
- [ ] No, I am just suggesting this.
